title: Lead Data Scientist - Classical ML
description:
Location: Chennai / Coimbatore / Bangalore / Pune 
 We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Scientist with strong expertise in Classical Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and data engineering technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and deploying scalable ML solutions, leading data science initiatives, and working closely with engineering and business teams to translate complex business problems into data-driven solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models for business use cases. Develop and optimize Classical ML models using XGBoost, LightGBM, Regression, Classification , and other relevant techniques. Apply Deep Learning and NLP techniques to solve complex business problems. Perform data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, and optimization. Work with large datasets using Python and SQL . Build and deploy ML solutions leveraging Azure services. Work with Snowflake for data storage, processing, and analytics. Monitor model performance and continuously improve model accuracy and scalability. Collaborate with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders. Provide technical leadership, mentor junior data scientists, and drive best practices across the data science lifecycle. Translate business requirements into practical, measurable ML solutions. 
 Required Skills 10+ years of experience in Data Science / Machine Learning. Strong hands-on experience with Classical Machine Learning . Expertise in: XGBoost LightGBM Regression Classification Feature Engineering Model Evaluation & Optimization Good experience with Deep Learning and NLP . Strong proficiency in Python and SQL . Experience working with Azure cloud services. Hands-on experience with Snowflake . Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistics, model validation, and data preprocessing. Experience leading or mentoring Data Science teams/projects. 
 Good to Have Experience taking ML models from POC to production . Exposure to MLOps / model deployment and monitoring . Experience working with large-scale enterprise datasets. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 Candidate Profile Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset. Ability to independently own ML projects from requirement gathering through deployment. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Strong technical leadership and communication skills.

title: IT Data Manager
description:
Job Title: Data Manager Department : Personal Investors IT About Business line/Function: CPBS Personal Investors IT 
 Position Purpose: The IT Data Managers responsibility is to foster operational compliance with Personal Investors’ data management provisions – within the DCIO’s area of responsibility- of data assets entrusted to her / him. This concerns especially requirements within the subject areas: Know-Your-Data (KYD), Data Modeling and Data Quality. In alliance with the Data Domain Manager, the IT Data Manager operationally performs IT specific activities that foster completeness and consistency of Personal Investors’ Enterprise Data Model (EDM) on all levels. The IT Data Manager should facilitate efficient management of Personal Investors’ data to leverage business growth, especially by supporting to deliver high-quality data, mapping data requirements from Business and AI use cases, while ensuring compliance to regulations (esp. BCBS 239) and BNP group standards, governing the DCIO‘s area of responsibility. 
 Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities The IT Data Manager ensures the correct, complete and timely inventory of Application Data Models (ADD) and logical data flows (data lineage) within the Enterprise Data Management Tool (WeData) and the PI KYD Application, of data assets entrusted to her / him. The role operationally ensures the business-logical conformity of data assets’ conceptual and application data models towards the KYD information model for a specific Business Domain. In course of his operational tasks, the IT Data Manager actively advocates compliance with and fostering the PI IT Data Governance framework, in the IT Sub-CoE’s Data Management (DCIO office) area of responsibility. In close collaboration with the Data Domain Manager and the CDO Office, the IT Data Manager fosters technical implementation of data quality controls, as well as the remediation of apparent data quality issues. Contributing Responsibilities In course of the KYD review of a respective application, the IT Data Manager interacts with relevant stakeholder - primarily IT Responsible and Business Application Owner – knowledgeable on an application’s data model, when reviewing a data asset within the respective Business Domain. Together, they identify the most accurate business context of inventoried data objects. She/he shall operationally support business teams (tribes, projects, functions) on the harmonious interpretation of a data asset’s business meaning. The completeness and accuracy of Personal Investors’ metadata within the respective dictionaries – with focus on critical data and technical metadata – shall drive the IT Data Manager’s activities. The IT Data Managers operationally supports the CDO office to identify convenient data quality controls throughout a data asset’s lifecycle and completeness of data lineage. 
 Technical & Behavioral Competencies 7+ years of experience in Data Governance and Protection Intrinsic motivation to analyze complex dependencies, while aiming for a high level of detail Expertise in Data engineering technology (e.g. SQL, ETL development) Possess very good English speaking and writing skills Work experience in Architecture modelling tools (e.g. Sparx EA, Collibra) – advantageous. 
 Specific Qualifications: Proven experience within a convenient area e.g. software development, data engineering, data management Proven experience within the area of data modelling/engineering and market’s best practice data management technologies. Basic knowledge on banking industry and securities trading – advantageous. Strong analytical capacity and the ability to comprehensibly explain and visualize complex contexts. Critical thinking, as well as committed, self-reliant and structured way of working. Organizational and communication skills with a confident appeal - Advantageous. Education Level: Bachelor’s degree or Equivalent Location: Chennai 
 About BNP Paribas Group: BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. About BNP Paribas India Solutions: Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. Own vendor/partner relationships (licenses, support SLAs, upgrades). Program KPIs: OEE uplift, yield improvement, deviation reduction , and batch release acceleration . Budgeting, capacity planning, and crosssite harmonization . MustHave Skills Deep expertise in MVDA/MSPC and operational deployment at scale. Strong working knowledge of GxP/21 CFR Part 11 , data integrity, CSV. OT/IT architecture understanding (networks, DMZ, cybersecurity considerations). The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and deploying data science solutions, applying advanced machine learning techniques, and leveraging emerging AI technologies to solve complex business problems. Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, data preprocessing, and statistical analysis. Develop and evaluate LLM-based and Generative AI solutions for real-world business problems. Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into applications and enterprise platforms. Monitor model performance and continuously improve accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Communicate analytical findings, model results, and recommendations effectively to technical and business stakeholders. Stay updated with emerging developments in Machine Learning, GenAI, LLMs, and Agentic AI .
